sources.entry: Cooklang skills by dubadub - Skills and an MCP server that let AI agents work with Cooklang recipes: plain-text .cook recipes and .menu meal plans in a folder you own.

summary.one_liner: A plugin and MCP server that let AI agents read, write, validate, search, scale and plan Cooklang recipes (.cook files) and meal plans (.menu files) in a local recipe folder.
keywords: what can i cook with what i have
summary.what_it_does: Packages 14 agent skills (step-by-step guides for writing, validating, searching, scaling, importing and exporting recipes, meal planning, shopping lists, pantry tracking, reports and nutrition) for several AI agent clients. It also provides the Cook MCP server, run through npx, whose tools read, search, validate and write the recipe files, build aisle-grouped shopping lists minus pantry stock, track pantry expiry, and render Jinja reports. Everything runs locally without an account. Nutrition evaluation and importing from photos or social links go through cook.md and require a Cook Basic or Cook Pro plan. The server picks its recipe folder from COOK_RECIPES_DIR, the client's workspace folder, or the launch folder.
use_cases: Writing and fixing Cooklang recipes with an AI agent
Planning weekly dinners and generating a shopping list
Tracking pantry stock and finding what can be cooked
Importing recipes from URLs, photos or pasted text
Scaling recipes to more or fewer servings
Checking a recipe collection for broken references
how_to_run: In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add cooklang/cooklang-skills
Codex: codex plugin marketplace add cooklang/cooklang-skills
Skills only: npx skills add cooklang/cooklang-skills
Claude Desktop or other MCP clients: add an mcpServers entry running npx -y @cookmd/mcp with COOK_RECIPES_DIR set to an absolute path
stack: cook.md service for nutrition and photo/social import (paid tiers)
notable: Skills and MCP server are packaged for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients
Recipe folder resolution: COOK_RECIPES_DIR, then the client's workspace folder, then the launch folder
Shopping lists grouped by aisle with pantry stock subtracted
Skills are copied from the cook-mcp repo and synced by script, with a weekly drift check
Free and local, with no account needed for core recipe features
caveats: No Windows builds yet; macOS (arm64, x64) and Linux (x64, arm64) only
Nutrition reports and importing from photos or social links require Cook Basic or Cook Pro
Skills here are a copy; the canonical versions live in cook-md/cook-mcp and should not be edited in this repo
Codex plugin servers cannot find recipes by themselves and need a separate server entry with COOK_RECIPES_DIR
